purpose: Preserve structural observations before semantic rejection without retrying consumed candidates

source_boundary.prospective_location: Between client.complete parsed-object return and _SourceTransport semantic validation, in a separate future adapter; frozen classes unchanged
source_boundary.actual_transport_limit: Current Transport.request rejects non-dict/error envelopes before returning. Observing its return is not observing every decoded JSON or raw HTTP bytes. Malformed offline fixtures do not prove expanded live coverage.
source_boundary.response_identity: Same original object reaches parser only after successful structural persistence; no fallback or answer replacement

scope.next_prototype: Separate offline-only fixture adapter in new files and disposable test directories; no real endpoint/key/model transport imports or arguments
scope.historical_experiments: HBT01/HBT02/HBT03 sources, owner/reservation/evidence, completed outcomes and E05 code/ZIP remain frozen
scope.live_enablement: Not included; requires a separate justified experiment and applicable existing authorization/pins before any real call
scope.baseline_gate: Existing durable reservation, once-only dispatch, no retry, four-complete response clinical gate remain unchanged

proposed_order: Verify permanent owner, fixed fixture scope, request/fixture/helper/parser pins and simulated identity checks
Exclusive durable reservation consumes fixture slot
Exclusive durable dispatch-possible marker links reservation; marker is not dispatch proof
Invoke registered fake dispatch at most once
Record in-memory parsed_object_observed; immediately call pinned helper before semantic parser
Persist structural-only receipt exclusively, flush/fsync file and directory, verify snapshot
Pass identical object to semantic parser stub; collect sanitized operational result separately
Simulate post-pin check, persist terminal linking reservation/marker/structure/pin-result hashes and sanitized outcome

recovery_contract.missing_evidence: Unknown is distinct from false; persist only supported observations
recovery_contract.unfinished_reservation: Always consumed, no resend even if fixture observer knew invocation count 0
recovery_contract.storage_failure: Stop before parser if structure was not durable. If possible write a separate sanitized local failure receipt including parsed observation; failure to save that too leaves only earlier durable evidence. No disk-error detail strings.
recovery_contract.incomplete_chain: Unknown/incomplete and no retry/export; terminal existence alone is not semantic success
recovery_contract.immutable_files: Exclusive creation, nofollow handles, directory identity checks and fsync barriers proposed; preserve partial files; never delete owner/reservation/marker or overwrite evidence
recovery_contract.power_loss_limit: Fsync ordering must be tested with fault injection; this design is not proof of power-loss durability on all storage devices

privacy.exceptions: Fixed stage/code enums only; no str/repr/traceback, arbitrary class names, response keys, paths, identifiers or bodies
privacy.reasoning: No body/hash; never substitute as final answer
privacy.content_hash: Not anonymization; any future actual per-response receipts remain private
privacy.synthetic_adapter_receipts: No actual patient data; do not copy body values even from fixtures

planned_test_groups.name: before_reservation
planned_test_groups.requirement: Stop before reservation; fake dispatch 0; no completion evidence; detected pin mismatch blocks the scope.

planned_test_groups.name: after_reservation
planned_test_groups.requirement: Stop after reservation durability; fixture invocation may be known 0 inside the test, but recovered unfinished reservation consumes the slot and remains unknown/no retry.

planned_test_groups.name: around_dispatch_marker
planned_test_groups.requirement: Stop after dispatch-possible durability immediately before or after fake invocation; marker proves possibility, not a sent request or response.

planned_test_groups.name: after_parsed_return
planned_test_groups.requirement: Interrupt after fake returns but before structural persistence; in-memory observed=true is not durable evidence; no invented recovery receipt.

planned_test_groups.name: structural_write_failure
planned_test_groups.requirement: Short write, flush/fsync failure or interruption leaves partial evidence and parser count 0; preserve files and prohibit overwrite/recreation.

planned_test_groups.name: after_structure_before_terminal
planned_test_groups.requirement: Parser failure or terminal write interruption preserves committed structural metadata; terminal absence is incomplete evidence, never success.

planned_test_groups.name: duplicate_and_other_output
planned_test_groups.requirement: Repeated fixture request or new output directory under same permanent owner produces 0 additional dispatches.

planned_test_groups.name: concurrent_writers
planned_test_groups.requirement: Only one writer may reserve/dispatch; second writer is blocked; stale lock is not auto-deleted.

planned_test_groups.name: evidence_integrity
planned_test_groups.requirement: Orphan, existing/partial file, changed hash, symlink or observed pin failure blocks; restoring bytes does not silently clear permanent block.

planned_test_groups.name: same_object_no_mutation
planned_test_groups.requirement: Helper sees original parsed object, parser receives identical object after persistence; no mutation, rewriting, alternate choice or fallback.

planned_test_groups.name: structure_vs_semantics
planned_test_groups.requirement: Normal/null/empty/whitespace/length/malformed synthetic objects retain structural observations separately from fixed semantic-stub outcome.

planned_test_groups.name: usage_and_reasoning_provenance
planned_test_groups.requirement: Persist helper output without normalizing unknown to 0 or removing original total state; no reasoning text/hash or token estimation.

planned_test_groups.name: exception_privacy
planned_test_groups.requirement: Transport/helper/parser/storage exceptions containing secret sentinels must not leak via files/stdout/stderr/tracebacks; allow fixed stage/code and validated numbers only.

planned_test_groups.name: all_four_review_gate
planned_test_groups.requirement: Four complete nonblank stop outcomes plus post-pin simulation and valid terminal links permit only a synthetic eligibility flag; any failed/unknown/partial result keeps the set closed; no actual export.

cost_scope.future_fake_invocations: At most one per fixture reservation; each independent test uses a fresh synthetic scope. Final total to be counted by implementation, not assumed from 14 groups.
cost_scope.duration_cost_note: No live API cost requested; implementation/reviewer work and elapsed duration are not estimated or asserted free.

acceptance_for_future_offline_prototype: All declared interruption and integrity groups verified with network denied and a deterministic fake invocation counter
No old production import or entrypoint changed and selected historical pins preserved
Structural persistence failure prevents parser entry; every reserved restart produces no dispatch
Private/public synthetic source copies and aggregate claims independently audited
